::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 10th 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 63
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)
Please send me a copy of [the Dove in the Eagle’s Nest](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd).[^1] 

I have got some of the books I wanted for my article from a school inspector, but I am afraid my ideas are not much more definite than when I saw you as to what would be likely to be of use - as I fear there is no book on English education analogous to [Mr Arnold’s on German](other_books/otherbook_903.qmd) and I can only pick up from all quarters[^2]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: With a note ‘Post 13/578, SH’.
[^2]: This projected article on English education, presumably for *Macmillan's Magazine*, does not seem to have been published.
